core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sema corresponds to the Arabic form سَمَا and is glossed in this record as “Sky, heaven.” The record associates the form with root س م و (s-m-w). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sema corresponds to the Arabic form سَمَا (Arabic root س م و (s-m-w); سَمَاء (Samāʾ)). Its core sense is sema; sky, heaven (turkish form). Sema is the Turkish form of Arabic سَمَاء (Samāʾ), meaning 'sky, heaven'; it occurs in the Quran.

persian.name: سما
persian.long_meaning: Sema (سما) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن سما، آسمان است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: सेमा

arabic.name: سَمَا
